title: Open SQLite state paths with question marks safely in Go
notes: A temporary state directory whose path contains a question mark left meta.sqlite3 empty while Go migrated a different file. Python migrated the intended file with the same path.
done_when: Test a state directory with reserved URI characters and verify that Go and Python open the same metadata and payload files, with no extra files created.
result: Open SQLite state paths with question marks safely in Go
evidence: Go migration tests verify the metadata and payload files for absolute and relative paths containing URI characters. A temporary Python/Go round trip passed in both creation orders.
